caption:
A fire right under the floor you walk on?
Roman central heating in seven simple fixes: a furnace outside, tile pillars, a thick floor, wall flues. Underfloor heating, 2,000 years ago. Which step would you have skipped?
#history #ancientrome #hypocaust #romanbaths #howitworks
pinnedComment: Extra fact: the name comes from Greek hupó (under) + kaustós (burnt). Vitruvius describes the system around 15 BC. Source: English Heritage, Baths and Bathing in Roman Britain
shortsTitle: Fire under the floor: how a Roman hypocaust worked
